nodes.label: Pairings Review Workflow
nodes.rationale: Each proposed item-pairing line is marked for manual review with ✅ keep / ❌ remove / ✏️ change, indicating this document is a draft cross-sell/upsell recommendation list intended for curation before being adopted as final pairing data (e.g. for 'frequently bought together' suggestions), rather than an already-finalized dataset.
